item.description: Rep. Ilhan Omar is responding after federal agents searched her home in Washington, D.C., on Monday morning, posting on social media “Make no mistake, this is an attempt to target political enemies.” The Justice Department is calling it part of an ongoing criminal probe, but Omar’s supporters accuse the Trump administration of a blatant abuse of power, less than three weeks before the midterm elections. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

item.description: A man died after falling from the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia on Monday, officials said. Horrified witnesses say the man flew out of the ride and slammed into other passengers before landing underneath the coaster. Six Flags has temporarily closed nine similar attractions in its parks in the United States and Canada “out of an abundance of caution” and an investigation is underway. NBC’s Ryan Chandler reports for TODAY.
